title: Use GPT Image 2 to generate a single storyboard, then animate it with Seedance…
content:
Use GPT Image 2 to generate a single storyboard, then animate it with Seedance 2.0 via Hedra to create a 2D funky animation  
Enable the High Quality setting in Hedra’s Seedance 2.0 UI for better output quality
